instruction: Disable the 'Save window positions on exit' option in GIMP preferences.

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to navigate to GIMP preferences and disable the save window positions on exit option. The evaluator checks the gimprc config file for 'save-session-info no'. Uses existing check_config_status metric and get_gimp_config_file getter.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 1.0 if save-session-info is set to no, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts GIMP config file from ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc
Metric correctly parses gimprc format and checks for save-session-info=no
Expected value 'save-session-info: no' correctly represents disabled save window positions
Postconfig appropriately closes GIMP (Ctrl+Q) to ensure preferences are persisted to disk
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the single requirement in the instruction
Edge cases handled: missing file, comments, empty lines in config
